agent_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)

WITH rep AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM rep) THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

SELECT category, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.review_score, t.product_category_name_english AS category FROM reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name) GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS y, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN date(order_delivered_customer_date) > date(order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY y
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY m ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT seller_id, SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price) AS ratio FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(x.f) AS avg_freight FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(freight_value) AS f FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) x JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = x.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_installments > 1 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_payments
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1)
SELECT CAST(strftime('%w', order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS dow, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY dow ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

WITH x AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS u, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) SELECT AVG(julianday(b.t) - julianday(a.t)) FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.u = b.u AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2

SELECT c.customer_city, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE WHEN julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) > 20 THEN 'slow' ELSE 'fast' END AS speed, AVG(r.review_score) FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY speed

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.seller_state <> c.customer_state THEN s.seller_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
